import { Canvas, Controls, Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; import { Token, getTokenData } from '@az-digital/storybook-addon-tokens'; import { ContractAnatomy } from '../ContractAnatomy'; import * as ButtonStories from './Button.stories'; # Button An action in a form, a dialog or a page: a label, and an optional icon, in a fully rounded shape. The button above is Arizona Bootstrap v5.3.0, compiled from its Sass with the white buttons patch in this repo's `patches/` folder. It doesn't match every value on this page yet, such as small buttons' line (23px, not 19px) and the outline Red and Blue buttons' hover fill (their own color, not the darker one in the table below, which follows the Figma designs). ## Colors The button's contract (`button.contract.json`) has a solid and an outline button for each brand color, each for a background. Their colors follow the Figma Buttons component. Blue isn't in the original XD designs.
Button On Fill Text Hover fill Hover text Pressed fill Focus ring
Red White, Cloud or Caliche Red White Sonoran Red White Red Bougainvillea
Outline Red White, Cloud or Caliche None, Red border Red Sonoran Red White Red Bougainvillea
Blue White, Cloud or Caliche Blue White Azurite White #3d4f6f Blue
Outline Blue White, Cloud or Caliche None, Blue border Blue Azurite White #3d4f6f Blue
Rain Blue or Azurite Rain Blue #65c0db, a darker Rain Tinta #9ad8ef, a lighter Rain Rain
Outline Rain Blue or Azurite None, Rain border Rain #65c0db, a darker Rain Tinta #9ad8ef, a lighter Rain White
White, Red text Red White Red Gray 200 Red Gray 100 White
Outline White Red or Arroyo Blue None, White border White Gray 200 Gray 800 Gray 100 White
White, Blue text Arroyo Blue White Blue Gray 200 Blue Gray 100 White
- **Keyboard focus:** a focused button looks the way it does on hover, with a ring 2px outside it. Its width is the shared . The ring is on the Red buttons, White on outline Rain and the White buttons, and the button's own color on the others. - **Pressed:** while it's pressed, a button fills its pressed color and keeps its hover text color. - **Colors that aren't brand colors,** such as Rain's hover fill, are recorded with a note saying why. ## Size - **Default:** 46px tall: 18px text on a 24px line, with 9px of padding above and below and 28px to each side. - **Small:** 29px tall: 16px text on a 19px line, with 3px above and below and 11px to each side. - **Large:** 55px tall: 22px text on a 27px line, with 12px above and below and 34px to each side, and 0.18px letter spacing instead of 0.14px. Every size has a 2px border, so outline and solid buttons line up, and fully rounded ends. The label is Proxima Nova Condensed Bold. An icon sits 4px from the label and doesn't change the button's height. Colors change over 150ms, ease-in-out, which hasn't been reviewed by design yet and turns off when someone asks for reduced motion. ## Anatomy The button with no size or color chosen: its shape and type. Its colors come from a color variant, Red when none is chosen. ### Sizes What each size changes. #### Small #### Large ### Colors Each color sets every color the button needs. #### Red #### Outline Red #### Blue #### Outline Blue #### Rain #### Outline Rain #### White, Red text #### White, Blue text #### Outline White

primary-components-containers-cards-card.content: import { Canvas, Controls, Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; import { Token, getTokenData } from '@az-digital/storybook-addon-tokens'; import { ContractAnatomy } from '../../ContractAnatomy'; import * as CardStories from './Card.stories'; # Card A title and any content in a Cloud box, to read where it is. It isn't a link. The card above is Arizona Bootstrap v5.3.0. Its `.card-body` is the slot: the title, then Body, written as HTML here and as the editor's rich text in a site. Type a header or footer to add one. Arizona Bootstrap gives a Cloud card its title and text colors only when the whole card is a link, so this card sets them with `.text-azurite` on its title and `.text-tinta` on its body. ## When to use it - **Use it** for content that's complete on the card, such as office hours or a short notice. - **Its body is a slot:** paragraphs, a list or a small table, all in the card's text type. It's the only card with one. Keep it short; for a whole section, use the page. - **Don't put links or buttons in the body to make a different card:** use a Quick Links Card or a Call to Action Card. - **It's the only card with a header and footer,** for a label above the content or a note below it. - **If the card should go to a page,** use a Link Card instead. ## Design decisions - **Fill:** , with no border: the fill sets the card apart from the page. In a forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, the card draws a 1px border instead. - **Shape:** 16px corners. - **Padding:** 24px between the card's edges and its content. The header and footer have 24px to the left and right, so their text lines up with the body's, and 12px above and below. - **Title:** 22px Bold, on a 30px line, in . 8px below the title's line. - **Body:** 18px Regular, on a 28px line, in : the same size as body text, for everything in the slot. 16px between blocks, such as a paragraph and a list. ## Anatomy Each part of the card and each of its design properties, from its contract (`card.contract.json`): the token it uses, or the card's own value and what it's for.

primary-components-containers-cards-icon.content:
import { Canvas, Controls, Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks';
import { Token, getTokenData } from '@az-digital/storybook-addon-tokens';
import { ContractAnatomy } from '../../ContractAnatomy';
import * as IconCardStories from './Icon Card.stories';

<Meta of={IconCardStories} />

# Icon Card

A Link Card with an icon above the title, which says what the page is about. The whole
card is the link.

<Canvas of={IconCardStories.Default} sourceState="hidden" />

<Controls of={IconCardStories.Default} />

The card above is Arizona Bootstrap v5.3.0. Hover it, or press <kbd>Tab</kbd> to
reach its title link, for its hover colors. The icons are the outline style of each icon,
at a light weight, to match arizona.edu.

## When to use it

- **Use it** in a row of cards that each go to a part of the site, such as Future
  Students, Current Students and Alumni, where an icon helps people find theirs.
- **Pick an icon for the page, not for decoration.** Screen readers skip it, so the title
  has to say everything on its own.
- **Use icon cards together:** in a row, give every card an icon, or none.
- **Don't put a button or other links in it:** the whole card is already one link.

## Design decisions

- **Icon:** 60px, in <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.azurite')} />, with 16px
  between it and the title's line. Use an icon font glyph at that font size, or an SVG at
  that width and height with `fill="currentColor"`. The icon is decorative, so hide it
  from screen readers with `aria-hidden="true"`.
- **Fill:** <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.bg.card.cloud')} />, with no border. In a
  forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, the card draws a 1px border
  instead.
- **Title:** 22px Bold, on a 30px line, in
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.azurite')} />. 8px below the title's line.
- **Text:** 18px Regular, on a 28px line, in
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.tinta')} />.
- **Shape and padding:** 16px corners, and 24px between the card's edges and its content.
- **Hover:** the fill turns <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.bg.card.cloud-hover')} />,
  the text turns <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.white')} />, and the icon and
  title turn <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.rain')} />. The title is
  underlined.
- **Keyboard focus:** when <kbd>Tab</kbd> reaches the title link, the card shows its hover
  colors, and the link's ring is Rain. Its width is the shared
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.focus-ring.width.md')} /> (2px).
- **Touch screens:** on a device that can't hover, such as a phone, the title is always
  underlined.
- **Motion:** the colors fade over 300ms, ease-out. The fade turns off when someone asks
  for reduced motion; the colors still change.

## Anatomy

Each part of the card and each of its design properties, from its contract
(`icon-card.contract.json`): the token it uses, or the card's own value and what it's for.

<ContractAnatomy contract="icon-card" />

primary-components-containers-cards-imag.content:
import { Canvas, Controls, Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks';
import { Token, getTokenData } from '@az-digital/storybook-addon-tokens';
import { ContractAnatomy } from '../../ContractAnatomy';
import * as ImageCardStories from './Image Card.stories';

<Meta of={ImageCardStories} />

# Image Card

A Link Card with a photo above the title. The whole card is the link, and the photo
zooms in on hover.

<Canvas of={ImageCardStories.Default} sourceState="hidden" />

<Controls of={ImageCardStories.Default} />

The card above is Arizona Bootstrap v5.3.0. Hover it, or press <kbd>Tab</kbd> to
reach its title link, for its hover colors and zoom.

## When to use it

- **Use it** when a photo shows what the page is about, such as a program or a place.
- **Crop the photo to 5:3,** and keep what matters away from the edges: it zooms in on
  hover.
- **The photo is decorative** when the title and text say what it shows, so leave its
  `alt` empty. Describe it only when it adds something the text doesn't.
- **Don't put a button or other links in it:** the whole card is already one link.

## Design decisions

- **Photo:** 5:3, cropped to fill that shape, in the card's top corners. On hover and with
  keyboard focus, it zooms in 8% over 250ms, ease, and zooms back out the same way. It
  stays inside the card's corners. The zoom still happens when someone asks for reduced
  motion, without the animation.
- **Fill:** <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.bg.card.cloud')} />, with no border. In a
  forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, the card draws a 1px border
  instead.
- **Title:** 22px Bold, on a 30px line, in
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.azurite')} />. 8px below the title's line.
- **Text:** 18px Regular, on a 28px line, in
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.tinta')} />.
- **Shape and padding:** 16px corners, and 24px between the photo or the card's edges and
  its content.
- **Hover:** the fill turns <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.bg.card.cloud-hover')} />,
  the text turns <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.white')} />, and the title turns
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.rain')} /> and is underlined.
- **Keyboard focus:** when <kbd>Tab</kbd> reaches the title link, the card shows its hover
  colors and zoom, and the link's ring is Rain. Its width is the shared
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.focus-ring.width.md')} /> (2px).
- **Touch screens:** on a device that can't hover, such as a phone, the title is always
  underlined.
- **Motion:** the colors fade over 300ms, ease-out. The fade turns off when someone asks
  for reduced motion; the colors still change.

## Anatomy

Each part of the card and each of its design properties, from its contract
(`image-card.contract.json`): the token it uses, or the card's own value and what it's
for.

primary-components-containers-cards-titl.content:
import { Canvas, Controls, Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks';
import { Token, getTokenData } from '@az-digital/storybook-addon-tokens';
import { ContractAnatomy } from '../../ContractAnatomy';
import * as TitleOnImageCardStories from './Title on Image Card.stories';

<Meta of={TitleOnImageCardStories} />

# Title on Image Card

A square photo with only a title on it. The whole card is the link, and the photo zooms in
on hover.

<Canvas of={TitleOnImageCardStories.Default} sourceState="hidden" />

<Controls of={TitleOnImageCardStories.Default} />

The card above is Arizona Bootstrap v5.3.0, with the markup in its Title on Image
docs. Hover it, or press <kbd>Tab</kbd> to reach its title link, for its zoom and
underline.

## When to use it

- **Use it** in a grid of choices that a photo and a word or two can explain, such as
  Undergraduate, Graduate and Online.
- **Keep the title short:** one to three words. There's no text, so the title has to say
  where the card goes.
- **Use any photo:** it's cropped to a square, and the gradient keeps the title readable.
  Keep what matters in the top half, above the title.
- **The photo is decorative,** so leave its `alt` empty: the title says where the card
  goes.

## Design decisions

- **Photo:** square, cropped to fill it. On hover and with keyboard focus, it zooms in 8%
  over 250ms, ease, and zooms back out the same way, inside the card's 16px corners. The
  zoom still happens when someone asks for reduced motion, without the animation.
- **Title:** 22px Bold, on a 30px line, in
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.white')} />, at the bottom of the photo, 24px
  from its left, right and bottom edges. Behind it, a gradient covers the bottom half of
  the photo, from transparent to <Token data={getTokenData('az.color.brand.blue')} /> at
  the bottom, so the title stays readable on any photo.
- **Hover and keyboard focus:** the photo zooms and the title is underlined. Its colors
  don't change: the photo covers the card. The title link's focus ring is White, so it
  shows on the gradient. Its width is the shared
  <Token data={getTokenData('az.focus-ring.width.md')} /> (2px).
- **No fill or border:** the photo covers the whole card.

## Anatomy

Each part of the card and each of its design properties, from its contract
(`title-on-image-card.contract.json`): the token it uses, or the card's own value and what
it's for.

<ContractAnatomy contract="title-on-image-card" />

The button reacts to hover anywhere on the card, and to keyboard focus. ## Anatomy Each part of the card and each of its design properties, from its contract (`call-to-action-card.contract.json`): the token it uses, or the card's own value and what it's for. primary-components-navigation-arizona-he.content: import { Canvas, Controls, Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; import { Token, getTokenData } from '@az-digital/storybook-addon-tokens'; import { ContractAnatomy } from '../ContractAnatomy'; import * as ArizonaHeaderStories from './Arizona Header.stories'; # Arizona Header The university's header bar, on every arizona.edu site: the wordmark, which links to the university's homepage, arizona.edu, with optional header buttons, such as Search and Menu, for small screens. The header above is the current release. It matches this page except for keyboard focus on the header buttons: they draw the ring every button gets, 2px outside the button, instead of the header's ring inside their edges. On a site, header buttons only show below 992px. ## Colors - **Blue** (default): the current, recommended header color. - **Red**: the original header color. It's being retired, so don't use it for new sites. ## Design decisions The header's contract (`brand-header.contract.json`) sets each of its parts' design properties: its colors are brand colors, its focus ring width is the shared one, its spacing comes from the spacing scale where a step matches, and its other sizes and its timings are the header's own values, written in the contract. The header has no design tokens of its own. - **Fill:** . The original red header isn't a separate set of design tokens: its contract points the fill at Red, and keeps every other color White. The red header is only needed until it's retired. - **Size:** the header is at least 50px tall, and exactly 50px below 992px. The wordmark fits a 211 × 16px box below 576px and a 266.41 × 19.8px box from 576px up, 10px from the header's left edge. It keeps its own proportions inside that box, so it's 211px and 266.41px wide and a little shorter than the box. - **Keyboard focus:** the logo and header buttons draw a ring inside their edges, with 2px corners, in . Its width is the shared focus ring width, (2px). - **Header buttons** (for adding search and menu toggles on mobile): at least 60px wide and as tall as the header, with (4px) of padding above and below. - **Label:** text in , 10px with a 10px line height, (2px) below the icon. - **Icon:** 24px square, the same color as the label. Use an SVG (inline or from a sprite) with `fill="currentColor"` so it picks up that color. - **Logo:** the university's white wordmark, , on both the Blue and the Red header. It's a registered university mark, so use the official file as it is: don't recolor, stretch, crop or redraw it, or add effects such as shadows. Use the wordmark header only on a page that also shows a Block "A" logo, usually in the site's branding just below the header. The university's logo guidelines cover the rest. - **Motion:** the off-canvas panel the header buttons open slides in over 300ms, ease-in-out, and the backdrop behind it fades in over 150ms. Header buttons change color and show their focus ring over 150ms. They haven't been reviewed by design yet, and all of them turn off when someone asks for reduced motion. - **Fixed on mobile:** when the header is pinned to the top of the screen below 992px, linked sections stop (8px) below the header when scrolled to (58px from the top), so the header doesn't cover them. ## Anatomy Each part of the header and each of its design properties, from the header's contract: the design token it uses, or the header's own value and what it's for.
